sections.title: Ember Awakening
sections.objective: Reach the first Ashen Gate and learn why the city is burning.
sections.preparation: Equip the Lantern Shard from the opening chest and keep one healing tonic.

steps.text: Follow the lantern marks out of the abandoned bell tower.
Inspect the dry well for a hidden lever.
Light the three braziers surrounding the Ashen Gate.

loot.name: Lantern Shard
loot.location: Opening chest in the bell tower

secrets: The bell tower mural names the city’s first keeper.
commonMistakes: Do not spend all ash at the first merchant; a tonic is useful at the gate.

sections.title: The Glassway Crossing
sections.objective: Cross the reflective causeway without alerting the ash sentries.
sections.preparation: Bring the Lantern Shard and at least two ranged attacks.

steps.text: Use the side path when the sentries face the central bridge.
Break the cracked mirror near the third arch to reveal a shortcut.
Defeat the Glassway Warden at the far platform.

secrets: A reflected door opens only while your lantern is dimmed.
commonMistakes: Rolling across glass tiles makes sentries investigate faster.

sections.title: Warden of Embers
sections.objective: Defeat the guardian blocking the inner district.
sections.preparation: Slot fire-resistant gear and save a tonic for the final phase.

steps.text: Stay near the arena edge while the Warden charges its opening sweep.
Strike the exposed core after its overhead slam.

boss.name: Warden of Embers
phases: Phase 1: sweeping halberd attacks leave a short opening.
Phase 2: the arena ignites in rings; move through the cooled gaps.
Phase 3: its core remains exposed longer after a missed charge.
boss.recommendedStrategy: Bait a charge, dodge sideways, then deliver one charged hit. Preserve stamina instead of trading blows.

secrets: The Warden can destroy the brittle pillars, exposing extra healing vials.
commonMistakes: Do not dodge backward during the ring attack; roll toward a cooled gap.

sections.title: The Lost Courier
sections.objective: Find a courier before the city’s gates are reopened.
sections.preparation: Speak with the tea seller after clearing the Gateheart Arena.

steps.text: Ask the tea seller about the scorched letter.
Search the rooftop laundry lines for the courier’s badge.
Return the letter to the courier beneath the east awning.

secrets: The letter contains a cipher pointing to a future district.
missableContent: Finish this quest before beginning the Inner Gate ceremony.
commonMistakes: The courier moves after each rest; check the east awning last.

sections.title: Cinder Relics
sections.objective: Recover the relics that record the ward’s final night.
sections.preparation: Use the Lantern Shard to spot relic glints.

steps.text: Collect the Ashen Locket from the bell tower rafters.
Collect the Melted Seal behind the Sootmarket fish stall.

secrets: Together, the relic inscriptions reveal a code for a later vault.
missableContent: Both relics disappear once the Inner Gate ceremony begins.
commonMistakes: The rafter path starts from the exterior ladder, not the tower stairs.
